stackDivergence.rationale: Immutable host UTF16 strings and explicit scalar iteration represent the original native Unicode value/escape loop; native pointer and buffer allocation ABI is not certified.

preservedResponsibilities: All original initialized protocol path productions, raw-versus-escaped delimiter rules, query/fragment stopping, file drive-bar conversion, per-part escape masks, default slash rules and source failure rollback. The returned full string represents the original mutable URI buffer, preserving Generic/Sftp whole-buffer emptiness admission. Actual absolute/relative class and HREF insertion consumers remain pending; no full URL/filter parity is claimed.
omittedResponsibilities: Full INetURLObject absolute/relative parsing, URIHelper SmartRel2Abs and HTML HREF insertion remain pending; tests do not certify compiled complete-class/native ABI equivalence.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Native URI path responsibility is split from the large original tools/source/fsys/urlobj.cxx while retaining original protocol/escape/pointer decisions; whole URL class integration remains pending.
